en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Quran is one, Revealed from the Presence of One<sup>azwj</sup>, but the differing come from the direction of the reporters’.
en.sarwar: 12. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad from al- Washsha’ from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Zurara from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Holy Quran is one. It has come from One, however, the differences come from the narrators.”
